districts.name: The Ninth Courtyard
districts.note: Rain keeps no banners. Keep your small light close.

districts.name: The Sundered Line
districts.note: A narrow road is still a road. Let no small light fall behind.

districts.name: Emberwatch Ridge
districts.note: Hold until the last warm light. Some promises need only presence.

districts.name: Lantern Exchange
districts.note: Trade your iron. Keep your word. The market remembers both.

districts.name: The Iron Wadi
districts.note: Nothing here is useless. Some things are only waiting for a second oath.

districts.name: Cinder Landing
districts.note: Every ship carries a leaving. Every lantern offers a return.

districts.name: The Far Watch
districts.note: Past the ridge, the old sentries still face the long dark.

landmarks.name: Read the relay
landmarks.title: A vow, left in the relay
landmarks.text: The child passed east. We lit every lantern. If you come after us, keep them burning. — Relay keeper, ninth watch

landmarks.name: Watch Morrow
landmarks.title: Morrow · rain condenser
landmarks.text: It counts each drop as if the desert were still listening. A patient machine. An older kind of courage.

landmarks.name: Inspect the Wayward Bell
landmarks.title: The Wayward Bell
landmarks.text: Three mismatched engines. One faithful hull. Her captain leaves a lamp in every port.

landmarks.name: Read the oath board
landmarks.title: No price for the lost
landmarks.text: Bring back the missing. Take no coin from the mourning. Some contracts are older than money.

landmarks.name: Listen at the Still Ember
landmarks.title: The Still Ember
landmarks.text: Pilots speak softly here. The barkeep keeps their names, and never their debts.

landmarks.name: Examine the fallen drive
landmarks.title: A heart without a hull
landmarks.text: The drive outlived its ship. The salvagers have given it a gentler duty: warmth.

landmarks.name: Inspect the sand crawler
landmarks.title: The patient caravan
landmarks.text: It moves one valley a year. Nothing that it carries is ever abandoned.

landmarks.name: Attend the watch beacon
landmarks.title: The far lantern
landmarks.text: A light is a promise made to someone you may never meet.

landmarks.name: Read the clan archive
landmarks.title: The iron remembers
landmarks.text: We inherit no throne. Only tools, names, and the duty to leave a road behind us.
